Continue subcutaneous heparin 5000 units for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis.
Monitor renal function with daily basic metabolic panel (BUN, creatinine, electrolytes).
Perform daily assessment of pain level and response to analgesics (oxycodone-acetaminophen, hydromorphone as needed).
